content.value_statement: Important decisions and notes often stay buried in chat history. This skill turns them into structured Notion pages with links, owners, and reusable context.
actual_capabilities: Clarifies the capture purpose, audience, freshness, and content type.
Selects a matching Notion database or template for decisions, FAQs, how-tos, learning notes, or documentation.
Uses Notion search and fetch tools to find prior pages for updates and links.
Creates structured Notion pages with summaries, context, tags, owners, dates, and relations.
Updates existing Notion pages when the captured knowledge already has a destination.
Adds backlinks, hub links, changelogs, and follow-up tasks when relevant.
limitations: Requires the Notion MCP server, remote MCP support, and Notion OAuth login.
Depends on available Notion databases, templates, and user permissions.
May need user input when multiple target databases are possible.
Does not independently verify facts beyond the provided conversation and connected Notion workspace.

use_cases.title: Record Product Decisions
use_cases.description: Convert a product discussion into a Notion decision page with alternatives, rationale, owner, status, and related specs.

use_cases.title: Publish Team How-Tos
use_cases.description: Turn troubleshooting notes or implementation steps into a reusable guide with prerequisites, steps, edge cases, and source links.

use_cases.title: Build Internal FAQs
use_cases.description: Transform repeated chat answers into concise Notion FAQ entries that link to deeper documentation and related pages.

prompt_templates.title: Capture This Conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture this conversation as a Notion knowledge page. Ask me for the target audience and page type before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Decision Log Entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Notion decision log entry from these notes. Include context, options considered, rationale, owner, status, and related links.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Notion for an existing page about this topic. Update the best match with new context, a short changelog, and links to related records.

prompt_templates.title: Organize a Knowledge Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these meeting notes into linked Notion pages for decisions, how-tos, FAQs, and follow-up tasks. Confirm databases before writing.

output_examples.input: A team chat agrees to use a new release checklist and assigns an owner.
output_examples.output: A Notion decision page with summary, context, alternatives, final decision, owner, status, related release docs, and follow-up tasks.

output_examples.input: A support thread explains how to troubleshoot failed customer imports.
output_examples.output: A Notion how-to guide with prerequisites, ordered steps, warnings, source links, and a short FAQ section.

output_examples.input: A recurring question appears in several onboarding conversations.
output_examples.output: A Notion FAQ entry with a concise answer, related pages, tags, owner, and links to deeper documentation.

best_practices: Confirm the target database and audience before creating or updating pages.
Link new pages to relevant hubs, source discussions, and existing Notion records.
Add owners, status, tags, and dates so captured knowledge remains maintainable.
anti_patterns: Creating duplicate pages without searching Notion for existing records first.
Capturing raw chat transcripts without extracting decisions, actions, and context.
Running Notion MCP setup or OAuth login without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill require Notion access?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs Notion MCP configuration and OAuth login before it can search, create, or update Notion pages.

faq.question: Can it update existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow searches and fetches prior pages before creating or updating Notion content.

faq.question: What page types can it create?
faq.answer: It supports decisions, how-tos, FAQs, concept pages, learning notes, and documentation pages.

faq.question: Will it choose the database automatically?
faq.answer: It uses reference guides to choose a database, but asks the user when multiple choices are possible.

faq.question: Does it preserve source context?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the assistant to include summaries, source links, related records, and changelog notes.

faq.question: Can it work without templates?
faq.answer: It can structure content from conversation context, but results are better with Notion database templates and schema guides.
